---
title: "Institute Vision & Mission"
---

```{r}
#| label: institute-vision-mission-content
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "_data_helpers.R"))

vm_df <- read_workbook_sheet(cf_sheet("institute_vision_mission"))

if (is.null(vm_df)) {
	notify_workbook_missing()
} else {
	vision_col <- trimws(as.character(vm_df[[1]]))
	mission_col <- trimws(as.character(vm_df[[2]]))

	vision_text <- vision_col[!is.na(vision_col) & nzchar(vision_col)][1]
	mission_items <- mission_col[!is.na(mission_col) & nzchar(mission_col)]

	cat("### Vision of the Institute {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	cat(vision_text, "\n\n")

	cat("### Mission of the Institute {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	for (item in mission_items) {
		cat("- ", item, "\n", sep = "")
	}
}
```
